hey can you look at our README.md for the retry-queue lib, i think it's trying to do too much. here's the current text:

# retry-queue

retry-queue lets you enqueue failed jobs and replay them later.

## getting started

first, install the package with `npm install @acme/retry-queue`. now create a queue: `const q = new RetryQueue({ backend: 'redis' })`. add a job with `q.push(job)`. you should see the job show up in redis under the `retryq:pending` key. now call `q.drain()` to replay all pending jobs and watch them run.

## API

`RetryQueue(opts)` constructs a queue. `opts.backend` is `'redis' | 'memory'`, default `'memory'`. `push(job)` enqueues a job and returns a promise that resolves when the job is persisted. `drain()` replays all pending jobs; it retries a job up to `opts.maxRetries` times (default 3) before moving it to the dead-letter queue. `opts.maxRetries` accepts any positive integer.
